tickerText: [TENNIS] Montreal QFs feature an all-2000s lineup as Shelton meets Mensik and Jodar faces Fils; Cincinnati qualifying opens today with Tsitsipas headlining after Sinner withdraws with a knee injury • [SQUASH] PSA Valencia Memorial Chimo Marmaneu opens in Spain with Patrick Rooney top seed; 2026/27 season also underway at PN Fleet Club Open in Karachi • [BADMINTON] Indonesia withdraws two mixed doubles pairs from BWF Worlds amid integrity probe; Ayush Shetty set for R1 clash with defending champion Shi Yu Qi in New Delhi Aug 17–23 • [PICKLEBALL] Carvana PPA Tour debuts World Pickleball Rankings for 2026–27; Veolia National Championships open the season Aug 31 in Cary, NC • [TABLE TENNIS] Miwa and Tomokazu Harimoto sweep WTT Champions Yokohama singles — sister beats Chen Xingtong 4-2, brother defends 4-1 over Oh Jun-seong

newsItems.title: Cincinnati Qualifying Opens
newsItems.excerpt: Cincinnati Open qualifying begins today with Stefanos Tsitsipas headlining the field; world No. 1 Jannik Sinner withdrew citing a right knee injury ahead of the Masters 1000.

newsItems.title: PSA Valencia Opens in Spain
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Valencia Memorial Chimo Marmaneu begins today in Spain, a $36,000 World Event running through August 15 with Patrick Rooney as the top seed.

newsItems.title: Indonesia Pairs Withdrawn from Worlds
newsItems.excerpt: PBSI pulled two mixed doubles pairs from the BWF World Championships in New Delhi amid an ongoing BWF integrity investigation into alleged match manipulation.

newsItems.title: Harimoto Siblings Sweep Yokohama
newsItems.excerpt: Miwa and Tomokazu Harimoto both won WTT Champions Yokohama singles — Miwa beat Chen Xingtong 4-2 and Tomokazu defended his crown 4-1 over Oh Jun-seong.
